meta.name: release-management
meta.description: Coordinate the release pipeline end to end: version numbering, release notes (internal and user-facing), changelog, build provenance, store/registry submission, certification checklists per platform (App Store, Google Play, Microsoft Store, Steam, consoles, npm/pypi/crates/Maven, container registries), staged rollout plan, post-release monitoring, and rollback. Produces a release plan, store-listing checklist, certification dossier, go/no-go report, and a post-release verification log. Use before any release and as the spine that pulls together TDD evidence, QA verdict, OWASP/CVE status, accessibility, localization, and DevOps deploy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统筹从版本号到回滚的完整发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要统筹一次软件发布的全部步骤
copy.tagline_en: Manage your whole release: versioning, store submission, rollout, rollback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage software releases and need a clear checklist across stores and platforms.

howto.what: 为软件发布做全流程协调:确定版本号、生成对内和面向用户的发布说明、记录构建来源与签名/SBOM、按平台准备上架检查清单、制定分阶段上线与回滚方案,并产出发布计划、go/no-go 报告和发布后验证日志。
howto.when: 在准备任何一次软件发布时触发,例如需要确定版本号、提交应用商店或软件仓库、规划分阶段上线。

say.text: 这次发布定什么版本号?请给出建议并锁定版本字符串。
say.note: Claude 会按版本命名约定给出方案。

say.text: 为这次 iOS 上架整理 App Store 的认证检查清单。
say.note: 它会按当前商店政策列出所需披露项。

say.text: 综合 QA、安全和无障碍结论,出一份 go/no-go 报告。
say.note: 报告会写明各环节结论、审批人和回滚路径。

howto.what_en: Coordinates release prep: versions, release notes (internal and user-facing), build provenance/SBOM, store submission checklists per platform, staged rollout criteria, post-release monitoring and rollback. Outputs a plan, go/no-go report, and verification log.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a release is being prepared, including versioning, store/registry submission, or staged rollout planning.

say_en.text: What version should this release get? Propose and lock the version string.
Create the App Store certification checklist for this iOS release.
say_en.note: It will list current required disclosures and signing steps.

say_en.text: Produce a go/no-go report from QA, security, and accessibility results.
say_en.note: The report names approvers, residual risks, and rollback path.
